title: SleepCogni: Can the SleepCogni Device (A Handheld Device That Treats Insomnia Using Biofeedback) Improve Sleep in Children With Chronic Insomnia?
official: SleepCogni: Can the SleepCogni Device (A Handheld Device That Treats Insomnia Using Biofeedback) Improve Sleep in Children With Chronic Insomnia?
summary: Can the SleepCogni device (a handheld device that treats insomnia using biofeedback) improve sleep in children with chronic insomnia?
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 6-16 years
* Chronic Insomnia, as defined by ICSD III
* Willingness to engage with the SleepCogni device by both parent and child/young person

Exclusion Criteria:

* Primary sleep problem is physiological, eg sleep disordered breathing
* Insufficient understanding of English language,
* Severe presentation, eg non-verbal, learning difficulties which mean child is unable to understand the purpose of the device.
* Children/parents already known to be unable to engage with behavioural strategies
